name: ADMASTON BROMLEY
ai_summary: The Township of Admaston/Bromley adopted Bylaw 2023-61 to establish regulations for backyard chickens. Concurrently, Council also adopted an amendment to its Fees and Charges By-Law 2023-62, establishing a new permit charge for backyard chickens.

name: BRUDENELL LYNDOCH AND RAGLAN
ai_summary: The Township of Brudenell, Lyndoch and Raglan is proposing a new comprehensive zoning by-law to update and combine its existing zoning regulations. This new by-law includes provisions that will permit backyard chickens as an accessory use to a dwelling unit, requiring chicken coops to comply with accessory building setbacks.

name: MELANCTHON
ai_summary: The municipality included an "Addendum to 2024 Development Charges Background Study" on its July 18, 2024, Hybrid Meeting Agenda. This signifies Council's active engagement with an update or revision to the foundational document used for establishing development charges within the municipality.

name: MELANCTHON
ai_summary: The municipality placed a "Revised Proposed Development Charges By-law" on its agenda for the council meeting held on August 15, 2019. This indicates that Council was actively reviewing and considering a revised version of the by-law at that time.
